newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Metal Ind shares rise.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Metal Ind shares rise.

text.p: Shares in Sumitomo Metal Industries Ltd rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Tuesday, attracting strong investor interest after lagging behind other firms in the sector during a recent rally, traders said.
By 0104 GMT, Sumitomo Metal"s shares were up 17 yen, or 6.14 percent, at 294. The issue was the third largest percentage gainer on the first section of the TSE.
Traders said investors had identified the share as having profit potential as it had lagged other stocks in the rally in large-capital shares such as steelmakers.

"The market is paying attention to highly volatile issues such as steel. Investors have started buying Sumitomo Metal Industries as that issue lagged behind the recent rally in steel shares," an official at a major securities house said.
"A situation where traders prefer dealing in large-capital shares is emerging in the market," an official at a medium-sized brokerage said.
